headline: Eko Build
title: Eko Build | Mark Then Stun | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Eko is a Wind Aniimo whose job is setting up debuffs. Sonar Attack hits ten times in a cone, and its last hit applies Weakness Mark, which cuts crit resistance. Then Arc Strike stuns enemies that carry the mark. Its trait Judgment Storm gives your whole team a Wind damage boost when it applies a debuff. Pair it with Wind attackers. Do you run Eko? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Eko is a Wind debuff support. Mark enemies with Sonar Attack, stun them with Arc Strike and let Judgment Storm boost your team's Wind damage.
